description: I’m looking for collaborators who want to help investigate what’s changing on Earth—where, how much, and whether it’s scientifically significant—using NASA datasets. You should join if you enjoy interdisciplinary problem-solving, learning fast, and building something meaningful in a 48-hour hackathon.
